desc: Read N and array A from stdin.
Build a doubly linked list (left/right arrays) and a treap (Node with key, prio, size, left, right) initialized with all indices.
Build a max-heap with initial adjacent pairs; store (-diff, dist, left_node) where dist is distance to current median rank.

While heap not empty: pop top, validate using alive flags and right[left] == left+1, add diff to total, mark nodes dead, erase from treap, link neighbors, update median rank, push new pair if both neighbors exist.
